title: Authorization boundary audit
summary: Verify that every privileged action checks who is acting and what they may do in code the actor cannot influence, with no check-then-act gap and no self-approval.

provenance.notes: Focuses on approvals, promotions and reviews: the places an agent system most often lets a model vouch for itself.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: The privileged flow: approval, promotion, review verdict, tool grant.

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: Missing authentication, caller-asserted identity, races and replay gaps with evidence.

workflow.step: Find where the actor's identity enters the flow. If it arrives as a plain field in the request, it is caller-asserted and therefore not authentication.
workflow.check: Identity comes from a verified credential or signature.

workflow.step: Find the authorization decision and confirm it runs in the same transaction or lock as the action it guards.
workflow.check: No window exists between check and act.

workflow.step: Check separation of duties: the author, reviewer and approver of one item must be different principals, including across different keys of the same principal.
workflow.check: A principal cannot verify its own work.

workflow.step: Check replay and scope: a grant should be bound to one action, one subject and one use, with an expiry.
Check the denied path: unknown, expired, revoked and malformed credentials must all deny and be recorded.

constraints: A matching hash or an LLM agreeing is not authorization.
Report; do not weaken a check to make a flow succeed.

examples.title: Trusted verifier list
examples.situation: Verification is accepted if verifierId appears in a list of trusted names.
examples.guidance: A caller can write any name. Require a signature from a key held only by the verifier.

verification: Each finding names the function where identity or authorization is decided.
Replay, race and self-approval are each considered explicitly.

task.text: Audit the approval flow for self-approval and a forged identity; check authorization and replay.
A permission check passes for an impersonated user; find the authentication gap.
